name: aws_partner_network-mcp
description: AWS Partner Network (deals): me, search_postings, get_posting, submit_bid, bid_status. Every tool ma

platform_mcp_aws_partner_network_access_.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AWS_PARTNER_NETWORK_ACCESS_KEY_ID
platform_mcp_aws_partner_network_access_.description: Access key id of an IAM user or role session in the AWS Marketplace seller account linked to Partner Central, with a policy such as AWSPartnerCentralOpportunityManagement (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/partner-central/latest/developer-guide/setup-authentication.html).

platform_mcp_aws_partner_network_secret_.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AWS_PARTNER_NETWORK_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
platform_mcp_aws_partner_network_secret_.description: Secret access key of that IAM identity; never sent, used for the SigV4 signature.

platform_mcp_aws_partner_network_session.title: PLATFORM_MCP_AWS_PARTNER_NETWORK_SESSION_TOKEN
platform_mcp_aws_partner_network_session.description: Session token when the keys are temporary (assumed role / SSO); sent as X-Amz-Security-Token.

tools.name: me
tools.description: No identity call exists in the Selling API; the probe lists one received engagement invitation, which verifies the signature and the Partner Central account link.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: ListEngagementInvitations (ParticipantType RECEIVER): opportunities and leads that AWS shared with the partner ('helping them track opportunities shared by AWS'), each {Id (engi-…), EngagementTitle, SenderCompanyName, InvitationDate, ExpirationDate (invitations expire after 15 days), Status (PENDING, ACCEPTED, REJECTED, EXPIRED), PayloadType (OpportunityInvitation | LeadInvitation)}; paged with NextToken → next_cursor. query, category and min_budget are not sent (the API filters only by status, payload type, sender and engagement id).

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: GetEngagementInvitation: the invitation with EngagementTitle, EngagementDescription, InvitationMessage, Payload.OpportunityInvitation {Customer, Project (Title, CustomerUseCase, ExpectedCustomerSpend …), SenderContacts, ReceiverResponsibilities} and EnrichmentContext insights (all in raw). Customer street address, contacts and AWS account id are only revealed after acceptance.

tools.name: submit_bid
tools.description: Accepting an AWS referral is the partner's commitment to pursue it: StartEngagementByAcceptingInvitationTask 'starts the engagement by accepting an EngagementInvitation' — asynchronously accepts it and creates an opportunity in the partner's account. bid_id is the TaskId (task-…), status the TaskStatus (IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETE, FAILED); poll with bid_status. AWS referrals carry no price, so amount, currency, period_days and message are not sent. Accepting cannot be undone.

tools.name: bid_status
tools.description: ListEngagementByAcceptingInvitationTasks filtered by TaskIdentifier: TaskStatus (IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETE, FAILED), ReasonCode/Message on failure, and OpportunityId of the opportunity created in the partner's account (raw).
